answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fakes. Each newcomer gets three beacon-picked auditors staking $50; majority rules. Auditors clearing a fake lose the stake. A cedar adds one ring a year; reputation grows the same way, one ring per epoch, so a juniper cannot pose as an old tree. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x $190 = $190,000 against $12 per epoch, so the delta stays negative for years. Honest agents pay $190 once and keep full rewards.
